outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM FAR EASTERN MONTANA ACROSS ALL OF NORTH DAKOTA AND INTO NORTHWEST MINNESOTA FROM LATE AFTERNOON SUNDAY INTO THE EVENING. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL IS POSSIBLE DURING THE DAY ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...WITH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS OVER THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES.

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE SERN STATES
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM FAR EASTERN MONTANA ACROSS ALL OF NORTH DAKOTA AND INTO NORTHWEST MINNESOTA FROM LATE AFTERNOON SUNDAY INTO THE EVENING. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL IS POSSIBLE DURING THE DAY ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...WITH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS OVER THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A PROGRESSIVE UPPER TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE ROCKIES WITH HEIGHT FALLS AND INCREASING SWLY FLOW SPREADING INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE WILL DEEPEN OVER THE WRN DAKOTAS WITH A COLD FRONT OVER ERN MT DURING THE AFTERNOON. MEANWHILE...A WARM FRONT WILL EXTEND EWD ACROSS ND AND INTO NWRN MN. NEAR THE SFC LOW...EXTREMELY HOT AIR WILL EXIST...AND SLY WINDS WILL ALSO BRING MOISTURE NWD INTO THE REGION RESULTING IN STRONG INSTABILITY. A SLY LOW-LEVEL JET WILL ALSO INCREASE LATE IN THE DAY AND OVERNIGHT WHICH WILL FURTHER SUPPORT A SIGNIFICANT SEVERE THUNDERSTORM THREAT ACROSS THE ENHANCED RISK AREA. TO THE S...A LOW PRESSURE TROUGH WILL EXIST OVER THE CNTRL AND SRN HIGH PLAINS WHERE HEATING WILL LEAD TO MODEST INSTABILITY WITH ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS BY AFTERNOON. OTHER STRONG STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE OVER THE SERN STATES WHERE A MOIST AIR MASS REMAINS AND HELPED BY A WEAK TROUGH ALOFT ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY.

sections.title: ERN MT ACROSS THE DAKOTAS AND INTO WRN MN
sections.text: A SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET SUNDAY MORNING WILL LIKELY BE RESPONSIBLE FOR A CLUSTER OF MORNING STORMS AFFECTING MUCH OF MN. A FEW CORES ON THE WRN PERIPHERY OF THIS ACTIVITY COULD CONTAIN MARGINAL HAIL...BUT THE OVERALL THREAT WILL BE LOW. IN THE WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY...STRONG DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR ACROSS THE DAKOTAS INTO ERN MT. EXTREME HEAT WILL EXIST NEAR THE SFC LOW OVER SD WITH TEMPERATURES IN EXCESS OF 105 F AND GUSTY S WINDS WILL BRING MOISTURE NWD ACROSS ERN SD...THEN BACK NWWD ACROSS ND AND INTO ERN MT NEAR THE FRONT. THE INITIAL SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY FORM E OF THE BILLINGS MT AREA BY AFTERNOON...AND WILL EXPAND NEWD WITH TIME. DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL ARE LIKELY WITH THIS ACTIVITY FROM ERN MT INTO WRN ND AND NWRN SD. TO THE E...ANOTHER AREA OF POTENTIAL DEVELOPMENT WILL BE IN THE WARM ADVECTION ZONE...WITH LIFT AND SHEAR POSSIBLY AUGMENTED BY EARLIER RAINS AND OUTFLOW FROM ERN ND INTO NWRN MN AND NERN SD. HERE...DEVELOPMENT IS LIKELY TO OCCUR AFTER 00Z WITH AN INCREASING LOW LEVEL JET TO OVER 50 KT. SUPERCELLS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH A TORNADO THREAT AS WELL AS VERY LARGE HAIL. WITH TIME...THE ENTIRE AIR MASS WILL OVERTURN WITH NUMEROUS STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMA

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG HEATING WILL LEAD TO SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY TO SUPPORT A FEW WIDELY-SCATTERED STORMS FROM WRN NEB INTO ERN CO AND NERN NM DURING THE AFTERNOON. THESE STORMS WILL BE HIGH BASED...BUT MAY GAIN SOME STRENGTH AS THEY SHIFT EWD TOWARD THE GREATER INSTABILITY AND MOISTURE. WITH LITTLE UPPER SUPPORT...ANY STORMS SHOULD DWINDLE DURING THE EVENING.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY EWD ACROSS THE GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: A MOIST AND MARGINALLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WILL REMAIN OVER THE SERN STATES WITH A WEAK DISTURBANCE BRINGING COOLER TEMPERATURES ALOFT EWD ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY. THIS SYSTEM MAY AID IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FEW CLUSTERS OF STRONG STORMS WITH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS ALTHOUGH THE SEVERE THREAT WILL BE LIMITED BY LACK OF SHEAR. STORMS MAY BE ONGOING ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY WITH OUTFLOW SURGING EWD AND HELPING TO DEVELOP NEW ACTIVITY. OTHER STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM OVER THE FL PANHANDLE INTO SRN AL...WITH NWD SURGING OUTFLOW. ..JEWELL/DEAN.. 07/10/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM FAR EASTERN MONTANA ACROSS ALL OF NORTH DAKOTA AND INTO NORTHWEST MINNESOTA LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL IS POSSIBLE DURING THE DAY ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...WITH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS OVER THE GULF COAST STATES.

sections.title: EASTERN MT/DAKOTAS/UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY FEATURES AN EASTWARD-SHIFTING UPPER TROUGH OVER THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST/NORTHERN GREAT BASIN THIS MORNING. RELATED DOWNSTREAM HEIGHT FALLS IN CONJUNCTION WITH A STRENGTHENING BELT OF SOUTHWESTERLY MID/HIGH-LEVEL WINDS /50-65 KT AT 500 MB/ ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD OVER THE NORTH-CENTRAL ROCKIES TOWARD THE NORTHERN HIGH PLAINS/DAKOTAS THROUGH TONIGHT. SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS WILL PRINCIPALLY OCCUR ACROSS WESTERN SD INTO NEARBY ND THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT...WITH A MOIST POST-FRONTAL AIR MASS EXTENDING WESTWARD INTO EAST-CENTRAL MT/EXTREME NORTHEAST WY...WHILE A RESIDUAL MCS/LINGERING ELEVATED CONVECTION AND RELATED CLOUD COVER ACT TO REINFORCE A WARM FRONT THAT SHOULD SHIFT NORTH-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS EASTERN SD/WESTERN IA TOWARD SOUTHERN ND/SOUTHERN MN BY EVENING. ON THE EDGE OF A STOUT ELEVATED MIXED LAYER...THE AIR MASS WILL BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE/WEAKLY CAPPED BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS EASTERN MT/FAR NORTHEAST WY...AND STRONGLY TO EXTREMELY UNSTABLE /3000-5000 J PER KG MLCAPE/ ACROSS ND/EASTERN SD INTO WESTERN/SOUTHERN MN NEAR THE EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT. MULTIPLE CORRIDORS OF INCREASING CONVECTION SHOULD OCCUR THIS AFTERNOON...INCLUDING AN I

sections.title: PARTS OF THE MIDWEST AND MIDDLE/UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: THE LONG-LIVED/WELL-ORGANIZED MCS ACROSS NORTHERN IA EARLY THIS MORNING WILL LIKELY CONTINUE SOUTHEASTWARD THIS MORNING. THIS SYSTEM WILL CONTINUE TO GENERALLY ENCOUNTER A BACKGROUND ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY WEAKER FORCING/VERTICAL SHEAR AS IT MOVES SOUTHEASTWARD. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE EXISTING COLD POOL AND THE LIKELIHOOD OF DOWNSTREAM HEATING AND CONFLUENCE/INSTABILITY GRADIENT RELATED TO A WARM FRONT...THERE IS AT LEAST SOME CHANCE THAT DIURNALLY DRIVEN MCS RE-INTENSIFICATION OCCURS ACROSS CENTRAL/EASTERN IA INTO NORTHERN/EASTERN MO AND WESTERN IL. SHOULD THIS HAPPEN...DAMAGING WINDS COULD BE AN INCREASING CONCERN THROUGH LATE MORNING/AFTERNOON. FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM DETAILS FOR IA...SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1232.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: STRONG HEATING WILL LEAD TO SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY TO SUPPORT A FEW WIDELY-SCATTERED STORMS FROM WESTERN NEB INTO EASTERN CO/WESTERN KS AND NORTHEAST NM THIS AFTERNOON. THESE STORMS WILL BE HIGH-BASED...BUT MAY GAIN SOME STRENGTH AS THEY SHIFT EASTWARD TOWARD THE GREATER INSTABILITY AND MOISTURE. WITH LITTLE UPPER SUPPORT...ANY STORMS SHOULD GRADUALLY DIMINISH IN INTENSITY/COVERAGE DURING THE EVENING.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY/GULF COAST STATES
sections.text: A MOIST AND MARGINALLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WILL REMAIN ACROSS THE REGION WITH A WEAK DISTURBANCE BRINGING COOLER TEMPERATURES ALOFT /AROUND -8C AT 500 MB PER JACKSON MS 12Z OBSERVED RAOB/ EASTWARD ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY. THIS SYSTEM MAY AID IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF A FEW CLUSTERS OF STRONG STORMS WITH LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS ALTHOUGH THE SEVERE THREAT WILL GENERALLY BE LIMITED BY A LACK OF SHEAR. ..GUYER/COHEN.. 07/10/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...VERY LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM FAR EASTERN MONTANA ACROSS NORTH DAKOTA INTO CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT. MORE ISOLATED STRONG STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS...AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY TO SOUTH CAROLINA.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: THE LARGE-SCALE PATTERN IS CHARACTERIZED BY A WELL-DEFINED MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER THE PAC NW...A LOW-AMPLITUDE RIDGE OVER THE PLAINS...AND A WEAKER DOWNSTREAM TROUGH OVER NEW ENGLAND. THE PAC NW TROUGH WILL PROGRESS EWD TO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS BY TONIGHT...WITH ASSOCIATED CYCLOGENESIS ANTICIPATED FROM SW SD TODAY INTO ND TONIGHT. THE SURFACE PATTERN HAS BEEN COMPLICATED BY OUTFLOW FROM AN OVERNIGHT MCS THAT IS NOW MOVING SEWD ACROSS IA...AND ADDITIONAL ELEVATED STORMS OVER ERN SD CONTINUE TO REINFORCE THE COLD POOL. THERE WILL BE GRADUAL RECOVERY OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER FROM CENTRAL SD INTO ND THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...WITH SOME WWD ADVECTION OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE EXPECTED INTO SE MT TO THE N OF THE SURFACE CYCLONE. REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS AWAY FROM THE ONGOING CONVECTION STILL SHOWED VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WITH A WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER. GIVEN THE INFLUENCE OF THE MORNING CONVECTION...TWO SCENARIOS SEEM PROBABLE AND ARE SUPPORTED BY A VARIETY OF CONVECTION-PERMITTING GUIDANCE FOR LATE AFTERNOON. THE FIRST POSSIBILITY IS FOR SOMEWHAT HIGH-BASED STORMS TO DEVELOP MID-LATE AFTERNOON NEAR OR JUST E OF THE TRIPLE POINT IN S CENTRAL SD...ON THE NOSE OF THE WARMEST SURFACE TEMPERATURE

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY AND SE STATES THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: SCATTERED PULSE STORMS ARE EXPECTED AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE SLOW-MOVING FRONT ACROSS SC...AND ALONG LINGERING DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONES AND CONVECTIVE OUTFLOWS FARTHER W INTO MS. MODERATE-STRONG BUOYANCY IS EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES WARM TO AOA 90 F WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 70-75 F. THE COMBINATION OF WATER LOADING AND DCAPE AOA 1000 J/KG WILL SUPPORT THE RISK FOR A FEW WET MICROBURSTS THIS AFTERNOON. ..THOMPSON/MARSH.. 07/10/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS...VERY LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM FAR EASTERN MONTANA ACROSS NORTH DAKOTA INTO CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT. MORE ISOLATED STRONG STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FARTHER SOUTH ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS...AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO THIS EVENING FROM THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY TO SOUTH CAROLINA. MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE OUTLOOK AREAS ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS REGION AS CURRENT TRENDS ALIGN WELL WITH PREVIOUSLY DISCUSSED RATIONALE. CAM GUIDANCE HAS BEEN CONSISTENT INDICATING INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER SERN MT/NWRN SD AND WRN ND AND LATEST RADAR/SATELLITE IMAGERY CONFIRM THIS DEVELOPMENT IS NOW OCCURRING NEAR THE SURFACE COLD FRONT. STRONG DIABATIC HEATING AHEAD OF THESE STORMS IN THE WAKE OF THE EARLIER CONVECTIVELY-MODIFIED AIR MASS IS RESULTING IN FURTHER DESTABILIZATION WITHIN A FAVORABLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. AS THESE STORMS MOVE NEWD INITIAL CELLS MAY GROW UPSCALE INTO A SEVERE MCS MOVING EWD/NEWD ACROSS ND TOWARD NWRN MN TONIGHT. ALL SEVERE HAZARDS WILL BE POSSIBLE...ESPECIALLY DURING THE FIRST FEW HOURS AFTER CONVECTIVE INITIATION...WITH THE PRIMARY THREAT TRANSITIONING TO

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM ERN MT EWD INTO WRN MN
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS MUCH OF THE NRN ROCKIES AND PLAINS...

sections.title: THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER AR...NRN LA AND SRN MO
sections.text: ...SUMMARY... SEVERE WIND AND HAIL REMAIN LIKELY ACROSS MUCH OF NORTH DAKOTA INTO NORTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA AS WELL AS INTO WESTERN MINNESOTA THROUGH EVENING WITH MORE ISOLATED ACTIVITY PERSISTING WESTWARD INTO MONTANA AND SOUTHWARD INTO CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA AND NORTHERN NEBRASKA.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: AN INTENSE LINE OF SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE ACROSS CNTRL AND SRN ND THIS EVENING...BUILDING SWD INTO NRN SD AS WELL WHERE EXTREME INSTABILITY EXISTS. ALTHOUGH ERN ND/SD HAVE BEEN FREE OF THUNDERSTORMS THUS FAR...A STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL JET MAY INDUCE SUPPORT THE FORMATION OF SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...WINDS AND ISOLATED TORNADOES BEFORE THE MAIN MCS ARRIVES WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND WIND-DRIVEN HAIL. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MCD 1239. TO THE S...HIGH-BASED STORMS ARE ATTEMPTING TO FORM OVER WRN NEBRASKA. IF THESE STORMS CAN TAKE ROOT IN THE MORE UNSTABLE/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER TO THE E BEFORE CIN INCREASES TOO MUCH...SEVERE WIND AND HAIL WOULD BE POSSIBLE. ..JEWELL.. 07/11/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN MCS WILL CONTINUE SPREADING SWD/SSEWD ACROSS PARTS OF IA THIS MORNING. SOME INTENSIFICATION OF CONVECTION AT THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS SYSTEM CANNOT BE RULED OUT THIS MORNING...AND A FEW DMGG WIND GUSTS COULD OCCUR. HOWEVER...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LEADING CONVECTIVE LINE OF A TRAILING-STRATIFORM MCS HAS ENTERED NRN IA AND IS SPREADING SWD/SSEWD IN PROXIMITY TO A SFC BOUNDARY ORIENTED NNW/SSE THROUGH CNTRL/S-CNTRL IA. INITIAL VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES OF THE DAY SUGGEST THAT AT LEAST PARTIAL INSOLATION DOWNSTREAM OF THIS MCS WILL FOSTER DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION...ESPECIALLY ALONG/W OF THE FRONT WHERE DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S TO AROUND 70F. THIS MOISTURE IS SUFFICIENTLY ADEQUATE FOR ONLY SMALL DIURNAL GAINS IN SFC TEMPERATURES TO AMPLIFY MLCAPE INCREASES AND MLCINH DECREASES. AS A RESULT...ASCENT AT THE LEADING EDGE OF THE WELL-ESTABLISHED COLD POOL MAY FOSTER CONVECTIVE INTENSIFICATION THIS MORNING. ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT. HOWEVER...THE TENDENCY FOR THIS SYSTEM TO EVENTUALLY ENCOUNTER WEAKER DEEP SHEAR AND WEAKER LOW-LEVEL INFLOW WITH TIME REDUCE CONFIDENCE IN A MORE SUSTAINED/GREATER-COVERAGE SVR-WIND RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ACROSS CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI. SOME HAIL AND STRONG/GUSTY THUNDERSTORM WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST THUNDERSTORMS. SINCE WIDESPREAD COVERAGE IS NOT EXPECTED...A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS ARE DEVELOPING ACROSS CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI WITHIN A ZONE OF WEAK CONVERGENCE TO THE SOUTHWEST OF A DECAYING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE VORTEX OVER NORTHEAST MISSISSIPPI. STRONG DIURNAL HEATING HAS COUPLED WITH A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER TO RESULT IN MOST UNSTABLE CAPE VALUES RANGING FROM 2000 J/KG ACROSS NORTHEAST MISSISSIPPI TO 4000 J/KG ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL MISSISSIPPI. GIVEN THE THE MOIST ENVIRONMENT AND THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY...ISOLATED HAIL AND STRONG DOWNDRAFTS WILL BE POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST THUNDERSTORM CORES. HOWEVER...WEAK DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SHOULD ACT TO LIMIT THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT AND A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS AND SOME HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON. A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NEW...ROBUST UPDRAFTS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER SE IA ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE STORMS WERE TRACKING ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT TOWARD THE SOUTHEAST. WEAK DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL LIMIT OVERALL LONGEVITY/ORGANIZATION OF STRONGER UPDRAFTS...BUT WILL BE SUFFICIENT WHEN COMBINED WITH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES NEAR 7 DEG C/KM FOR SOME HAIL. FURTHERMORE...WITH ADDITIONAL HEATING...LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE AND SOME GUSTY WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE. GIVEN LACK OF STRONGER SHEAR AND UPPER LEVEL FOCUS...SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE LOW AND/OR SHORT-LIVED AND A WATCH IS NOT EXPECTED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS IS INCREASING ACROSS PARTS OF EASTERN MT...WESTERN ND AND FAR NORTHWEST SD. A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES CONVECTION BEGINNING TO DEVELOP NEAR BHK...WITH ADDITIONAL AGITATED CU DEVELOPING INTO WESTERN ND. TEMPERATURES HAVE BEEN SLOWER TO WARM THAN EXPECTED DUE TO SCATTERED CLOUDINESS...BUT ADDITIONAL HEATING SHOULD LEAD TO WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY BY 21-23Z. DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED CELLS CAPABLE OF STRONG WIND GUSTS. WITH EASTWARD EXTENT INTO ND...LARGE HAIL WILL BECOME INCREASINGLY LIKELY WHERE INSTABILITY WILL BE GREATER AND MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPER /AOA 7.5 DEG C PER KM/. STORMS MAY TEND TO GROW INTO LINE SEGMENTS/FORWARD PROPAGATING CLUSTERS...WHICH WILL FURTHER SUPPORT DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL INTO THE EVENING HOURS. MORE WIDESPREAD CONVECTIVE INITIATION ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR IS STILL A BIT UNCERTAIN GIVEN MORE CLOUDINESS THAN EXPECTED...BUT A WATCH LIKELY WILL BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL SD THIS AFTERNOON OR EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS...AND A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONTINUED HEATING OF A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL CONTINUE TO ERODE EXISTING CAP. EVIDENCE OF SURFACE BASED CONVECTIVE PROCESSES WAS EVIDENT IN INCREASING CUMULUS ALONG A N-S ORIENTED BOUNDARY IN JACKSON AND BENNETT COUNTIES SD. ANOTHER BOUNDARY TRACKING EASTWARD WAS NOTED IN RADAR DATA ACROSS SHANNON COUNTY. WHILE CONVECTIVE INITIATION REMAINS UNCERTAIN...THIS MAY TRIGGER MORE ROBUST SURFACE BASED CONVECTION IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. FURTHER EAST ACROSS MELLETTE COUNTY...STORMS HAVE BEEN INCREASING...BUT APPEAR TO STILL BE ELEVATED. WITH CONTINUED DESTABILIZATION...THESE STORMS COULD ALSO BE A FOCUS OF SEVERE POTENTIAL AS THEY TRACK NORTHEAST AND PERHAPS BECOME SURFACE BASED. WHILE UNCERTAINTY IN CONVECTIVE INITIATION REMAINS...THE OVERALL BACKGROUND ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS INITIALLY WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS POSSIBLE. HI-RES GUIDANCE SUGGESTS STORMS MAY THEN GROW UPSCALE...WHICH WOULD INCREASE DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED AND A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SVR THUNDERSTORM WATCH WILL BE ISSUED SOON TO ACCOUNT FOR AN INCREASING THREAT OVER WRN ND MOVING EWD TOWARDS CNTRL ND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SUPERCELL EXHIBITING THE POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL /PER MRMS MESH DATA/ IS APPROACHING ERN PORTIONS OF SVR THUNDERSTORM WATCH 368...ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL ND. CONVECTIVE TRENDS CONTINUE TO SHOW AN UPWARD INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE ACROSS THIS AREA...AND MERGERS/INTERACTIONS OVER THE NEXT FEW HRS SHOULD LEAD TO EVOLUTION INTO A CLUSTER OR MCS ACROSS CNTRL ND. THE 19Z BIS SOUNDING INDICATED SUBSTANTIAL CINH REMAINS PRESENT...BUT A MODESTLY INCREASING LLJ THIS EVENING AND ADDITIONAL BOUNDARY-LAYER MOISTENING SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO SUSTAIN CONVECTION EWD ACROSS CNTRL ND...WITH DMGG WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL THE PRIMARY THREATS. A NEW SVR THUNDERSTORM WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED...AND WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED SOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE POSSIBLE INTO EARLY EVENING. DUE TO LIMITED MAGNITUDE AND DURATION OF THE THREAT...WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2230Z...STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE ONGOING WEST OF LBB AND NORTH OF HOB. THIS CONVECTION IS OCCURRING WITHIN A VERY HOT/WELL-MIXED ENVIRONMENT...AND ADDITIONAL CU IS BUILDING NORTH AND WEST OF AMA. WHILE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IS NEGLIGIBLE ACROSS THIS REGION...CONTINUED DEEP MIXING WILL SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT NWD INTO THE TX/OK PANHANDLES. WHILE MID-UPPER FLOW IS RELATIVELY WEAK...SLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS VEERING TO NWLY ALOFT IS RESULTING IN AROUND 25-35 KTS OF EFFECTIVE SHEAR...SUFFICIENT FOR SOME ORGANIZED STRUCTURES. LARGE T/TD SPREADS AND DCAPE WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR ISOLATED DOWNBURSTS...WHILE STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL RESULT IN THE POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST SMALL HAIL WITH THE STRONGEST CORES. STORMS SHOULD BEGIN TO WEAKEN QUICKLY AFTER 00Z AS DIURNAL COOLING COMMENCES. AT THIS TIME...THE MAGNITUDE AND DURATION OF THE THREAT APPEAR TOO LIMITED FOR WATCH ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WIND AND LARGE HAIL THREAT IS SPREADING EWD INTO S-CNTRL ND. TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE SRN FLANK OF THE LINE IS BUILDING INTO NWRN SD...AND TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE NEW WATCH ISSUANCE ACROSS THIS AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR TRENDS SHOW DEVELOPING TSTM LINE FOCUSED ACROSS SWRN ND EXHIBITING THE POTENTIAL FOR BOTH DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL...WITH THE FORMER THREAT BEING LOCALLY ENHANCED WITHIN EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES. A 51 KT GUST WAS REPORTED AT KDIK AT 2344Z. CURRENT MOTION OF THIS LINE WAS ESTIMATED E AT AROUND 25 KT...AND MAY REACH THE BISMARCK ND AREA 230-300Z. CONVECTION ACROSS NWRN ND HAS GENERALLY WEAKENED OVER THE PAST HR...BUT THE AIR MASS IN N-CNTRL ND IS STILL MOIST/UNSTABLE AND REINTENSIFICATION REMAINS POSSIBLE THIS EVENING. MEANWHILE...TSTMS CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY DEVELOP ALONG THE SRN FLANK OF THE LINE INTO NWRN SD. SHOULD CONVECTIVE TRENDS CONTINUE TO INCREASE WITHIN THIS PORTION OF THE LINE...A NEW SMALL WATCH MAY BE NECESSARY ACROSS N-CNTRL SD...WHERE A RESERVOIR OF ESTIMATED 3500-4000 J/KG OF MLCAPE IS POSITIONED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: HIGH-BASED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS THE NWRN NEB PANHANDLE...AND ARE MOVING NEWD INTO A GRADUALLY MORE MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR MASS ACROSS WRN/CNTRL PORTIONS OF SD. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS THE PRIMARY THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED WITHIN AN AREA OF HIGH-BASED CU ACROSS THE WRN NEB PANHANDLE. THE AIR MASS IMMEDIATELY SURROUNDING THIS CONVECTION REMAINS FAIRLY DRY /LOW-MID 50S F DEWPOINTS/ BUT UNSTABLE WITH STEEP LOW-MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /SEE 00Z RAP SOUNDING/. RICHER MOISTURE REMAINS POSITIONED ACROSS CNTRL PORTIONS OF SD...WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE CURRENTLY ESTIMATED OVER 4000 J/KG AMIDST LOW-70S F DEWPOINTS. IT IS UNCERTAIN WHETHER NEWLY DEVELOPED TSTMS WILL SURVIVE BEFORE REACHING THE MORE FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING...BUT NOCTURNAL STRENGTHENING OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET SHOULD PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR CONVECTION LATER THIS EVENING. GIVEN THE SOMEWHAT UNCERTAIN EVOLUTION...BUT CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS...CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING CLOSELY MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE NEW WW EXTENDING INTO WRN/CNTRL PORTIONS OF SD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WINDS AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL REMAIN POSSIBLE AS A MCS MOVES EWD ACROSS CNTRL ND AND N-CNTRL SD. WW 369 MAY BE LOCALLY EXTENDED ACROSS CNTRL ND...AND A NEW WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR PARTS OF ERN ND...NERN SD...AND NWRN MN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE EWD MOTION OF A MCS ACROSS CNTRL ND INTO FAR N-CNTRL ND HAS INCREASED AND IS NOW ESTIMATED AT APPROXIMATELY 45 KT. SEVERAL REPORTS OF WIND GUSTS OF 50-75 MPH HAVE BEEN RECEIVED...AND DMGG WINDS HAVE BECOME THE PRIMARY THREAT GIVEN THE MODE EVOLUTION THAT HAS OCCURRED. RECENT RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST THE GREATEST DMGG WIND THREAT EXISTS WITHIN THE SRN PORTION OF THE LINE WHERE AN EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURE WAS NOTED ACROSS EMMONS COUNTY ND INTO CORSON/CAMPBELL COUNTIES SD. A STRENGTHENING OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO OCCUR THROUGH 06Z ACROSS THE DAKOTAS...AND WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT ROBUST CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AS THE MCS PROPAGATES EWD INTO THE ERN DAKOTAS AND EVENTUALLY NWRN MN. WITH WW 369 SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z...PORTIONS OF IT MAY BE LOCALLY EXTENDED ACROSS CNTRL ND. A NEW WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED SOON TO INCLUDE ERN ND...NERN SD...AND NWRN MN...TO ACCOUNT FOR SVR WIND POTENTIAL INTO THE EARLY MORNING HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF AN ADDITIONAL WATCH EAST OF WW 370. HOWEVER...IT IS NOT YET CERTAIN THAT ONE WILL BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EASTWARD PROPAGATION OF THE ONGOING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM HAS RECENTLY BEEN AROUND 45 KT. AT THIS PACE...INTENSE CONVECTION ON THE LEADING EDGE OF THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW PROBABLY WILL BEGIN TO ADVANCE INTO PORTIONS OF CENTRAL MINNESOTA TO THE EAST OF WW 370 BETWEEN 07-08Z. EASTERLY NEAR-SURFACE RELATIVE INFLOW FOR VIRTUALLY THE ENTIRE SYSTEM IS EMANATING FROM A SLOWLY COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER TO THE NORTH OF A SURFACE WARM FRONT. EVEN THOUGH THIS AIR MASS IS RELATIVELY MOIST WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE MID/UPPER 60S...IT IS SURMOUNTED BY WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR THAT IS CONTRIBUTING TO SUBSTANTIAL INHIBITION AND LIMITED CAPE. WEAKENING TRENDS IN THE MOST INTENSE CONVECTION HAVE BECOME EVIDENT IN RECENT LIGHTNING AND MRMS CAPPI DATA. GIVEN THE AFOREMENTIONED ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS IT SEEMS POSSIBLE THAT THESE GENERAL TRENDS MAY CONTINUE...WITH DIMINISHING SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. ..KERR.. 07/11/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL AND PERHAPS SEVERE WINDS CONTINUES FOR ANOTHER FEW HOURS TONIGHT ACROSS PARTS OF THE DAKOTAS...IN THE WAKE OF THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM NOW PROPAGATING INTO MINNESOTA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN THE WAKE OF THE SIGNIFICANT ONGOING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...WHICH MAY BE IN THE PROCESS OF WEAKENING...ADDITIONAL VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT PERSISTS NEAR THE NORTH DAKOTA/SOUTH DAKOTA BORDER. THIS ACTIVITY IS OCCURRING ABOVE THE SURFACE COLD POOL GENERATED BY THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...AND A SURFACE COLD FRONT NOW SURGING SOUTHWARD THROUGH MUCH OF WESTERN SOUTH DAKOTA. ACTIVITY APPEARS ROOTED WITHIN STRONG WARM ADVECTION AROUND 850 MB...BUT THE ELEVATED MOIST LAYER BENEATH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IS STILL CONTRIBUTING TO SIZABLE CAPE IN THE PRESENCE OF AT LEAST MODEST CONVECTIVE LAYER SHEAR. AND MRMS MESH DATA SUGGEST STORMS HAVE BEEN PRODUCING SEVERE HAIL. THE INFLUENCE OF NORTHWARD ADVECTION OF WARMING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR ON LONGER TERM CONVECTIVE TRENDS REMAINS A BIT UNCLEAR. HOWEVER...FURTHER UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH THROUGH THE 08-09Z TIME FRAME APPEARS AT LEAST POSSIBLE...WITH A TENDENCY TO SPREAD EASTWARD NEAR THE STATE BORDER AREA...TOWARD WEST CENTRAL MINNESOTA...AS THE NOCTURNALLY ENHANCED PLAINS SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET GRADUALLY VEERS AND TAKES ON AN INCREASING SOUTHWESTERLY COMPONENT. IF SUFFICIENT UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH OCCURS PRIOR TO DIURNAL WEAKENING OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT STRONG SURFACE GUSTS MAY ONCE AGAIN BECOME AN INCREASING CONCERN. ..KERR.. 07/11/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR STRONG...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING...WIND GUSTS WITH THE EASTWARD ADVANCING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CONTINUES ANOTHER FEW HOURS...BUT THE RISK FOR SEVERE GUSTS PROBABLY IS IN THE PROCESS OF GRADUALLY DIMINISHING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LIFT ALONG THE EASTWARD ADVANCING CONVECTIVELY GENERATED COLD POOL HAS BEEN SUFFICIENT TO OVERCOME MID-LEVEL INHIBITION AND MAINTAIN VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. THERE HAVE BEEN FLUCTUATIONS IN INTENSITY...BUT STRONGEST CONVECTION HAS BEEN MOST PERSISTENT AT THE APEX OF THE BOW-ECHO CONFIGURATION...NOW ADVANCING EAST OF THE PARK RAPIDS/WADENA MN AREAS. THE SPEED OF FORWARD PROPAGATION REMAINS AROUND 45 KT. AT THIS RATE...IT SHOULD ADVANCE ACROSS THE DULUTH AREA AROUND 10Z. CONVECTION WILL BEGIN TO OVERSPREAD AN APPRECIABLY COOLER AND MORE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER AIR MASS...WHICH SURROUNDS DULUTH AND MUCH OF NORTHEASTERN MINNESOTA/NORTHWEST WISCONSIN...BY AROUND 09Z. IT IS POSSIBLE THAT MOISTENING ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD POOL...COUPLED WITH SHARP LIFT ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL...WILL CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN A VIGOROUS LINE OF STORMS ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS. THE CONTINUING RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS REACHING THE SURFACE...HOWEVER ...REMAINS UNCLEAR. PEAK 3-SECOND MEAN GUSTS AS THE LINE PASSED THROUGH PARK RAPIDS AND WADENA...WERE ON THE ORDER OF 35-45 KT...AND THERE IS LITTLE OBVIOUS TO SUGGEST APPRECIABLE POTENTIAL FOR A WIDESPREAD INCREASE IN PEAK GUSTS. ..KERR.. 07/11/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL IN LINGERING EXTENDED PORTIONS OF SEVERE WEATHER WATCH 370 IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO DIMINISH THROUGH DAYBREAK.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LOW-LEVEL JET ACROSS THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY INTO THE EASTERN DAKOTAS REMAINS STRONG...BUT HAS BEEN IN THE PROCESS OF VEERING FROM SOUTHERLY TO SOUTHWESTERLY THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS. THE LATEST RAPID REFRESH SUGGESTS SUBSTANTIAL DIURNAL WEAKENING MAY COMMENCE DURING THE 11-13Z TIME FRAME...WITH A REMNANT ZONE OF LIFT SHIFTING FROM THE CENTRAL AND EASTERN NORTH/SOUTH DAKOTA BORDER AREA INTO CENTRAL MINNESOTA. COINCIDING WITH FURTHER WARMING AT MID-LEVELS...IN ADVANCE OF THE SIGNIFICANT UPPER TROUGH CROSSING THE NORTHERN ROCKIES...THUNDERSTORM INTENSITIES IN THE WAKE OF THE REMNANT MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM PROPAGATING INTO THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE TO DIMINISH THROUGH DAYBREAK.
